posts.title: Chisholm to the Jays, per reports
posts.description: ST PETERSBURG, FLORIDA - OCTOBER 03: Jazz Chisholm Jr. #13 of the New York Yankees looks on during batting practice before game one of the American League Division Series against the Tampa Bay Rays at Tropicana Field on October 03, 2026 in St Petersburg, Florida. (Photo by Mike Stobe/Getty Images) | Getty Images Jazz Chisholm, Jr., and the Toronto Blue Jays have agreed to terms on a contract, per reports. Jeff Passan says that it is a one year deal with a $6 million signing bonus, $12.5 million 2027 salary, and a $16 million player option for 2028 with a $1.5 million buyout. If Chisholm declines the option, per Passan, it becomes a $40 million team option. Its a weird contract for one of the more difficult to project free agents in this year’s class. We discussed, when we did our Chisholm free agent poll earlier this month, that the projections for him were all over the map. posts.title: Rangers sign reliever Jimenez, per reports
posts.description: ATLANTA, GA - JULY 04: Sidelined Atlanta Braves relief pitcher Joe Jimenez in the dugout during the Saturday evening MLB game between the Atlanta Braves and the New York Mets on July 4, 2026 at Truist Park in Atklanta, Georgia. (Photo by David J. Griffin/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Joe Jimenez, a 31 year old righthanded reliever, is signing a minor league deal with the Texas Rangers, per multiple reports. Jimenez is a fastball/slider guy who came up in the Detroit Tigers organization, pitching out of their bullpen from 2017-22 before being traded to the Atlanta Braves in the 2022-23 offseason. After a strong 2023 season, the Braves signed Jimenez to a 3 year, $26 million deal. He had an excellent 2024 season, but then missed all of 2025 and 2026 due to knee surgery. posts.description: PHOENIX, AZ - SEPTEMBER 12: Kumar Rocker #80 of the Texas Rangers pitches during the game between the Texas Rangers and the Arizona Diamondbacks at Chase Field on Saturday, September 12, 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona.
